Inventory is exhaustive path/hash accounting; semantic review is explicitly targeted, not 1035-file security approval.
No alert dismissal, suppression, threshold changes, benchmark deletion or publication performed.

files.method: Targeted semantic review of capability verification, policy/plane bindings, FD ownership, audit intent/commit, AES-GCM AAD and bounded reads; existing negative tests exercised.
files.observations: Directory/lock/read descriptors have finally cleanup. Plane chmod/hardlink checks and capability expiry checks are present. Local administrator/OS owner is trusted; independent rollback anchoring and live IAM are not established.

files.method: Trace capture to enqueue to worker to stored descriptor, loss accounting and privacy branches; existing failure/queue/capacity tests exercised.
files.observations: Legacy BytePrivacyPolicy transforms on worker and retains raw queued memory; DeploymentPolicy ContentProtector acts before enqueue. Queue admission is not durable storage.

files.method: Review no-follow traversal, ExitStack callbacks, descriptor identity, separate review namespace, byte length/digest readback; run resolver tests.
files.observations: ExitStack cleanup covers read failure regression. Resolver binds caller-provided descriptor to bytes; it is not authenticated source truth. DeploymentPolicy descriptor fields are outside the legacy resolver field set.

files.method: Review encrypted file read/write, fsync admission, replay identities, recovery counters and bounded close; run crash/failure tests.
files.observations: Pre-admission crash remains unknown; flush may settle terminal loss, so health counters must be consulted. Tests cover missing durable entries and persisted unknown counters.

files.method: Review HTTPS validation and response bounds, persistent outbox owner, recovery and result/cursor progression; run partial-ack/fsync/restart tests.
files.observations: HTTP 200 alone is not full acceptance; separate node acceptance from destination durability. Path-based outbox operations are weaker against hostile ancestor replacement than FD-pinned byte spool; no exploit established in trusted-owner scope.

files.method: Review start/capture/end, ContextVar inheritance, exception preservation, stream lifecycle, snapshot and explicit seal refusal; run call tests.
files.observations: Only admitted call records can affect seal checks. Detached activity not yet registered is not enumerated by root completion. Existing conservative snapshot flags remain required.

files.method: Review closed projection over span/resource/link/status/scope surfaces, strict scalar validation, fail-closed projection and exporter exceptions; run projection tests.
files.observations: Fabric-managed route is protected; independent host exporters remain outside boundary. Explicit capture_content=True is raw pass-through.

files.method: Review closed canonical policy, digest, immutable snapshots, omit/redact/tokenize/retain modes and transform failures; run policy tests including queue interception.
files.observations: Production flags are declarations rather than proof of TLS/KMS/retention. Synchronous customer redactor can delay capture: input byte bound is not an execution-time bound.

files.method: Read identifier validation and runtime protocols, distinguish type contracts from enforced storage guarantees.
files.observations: Protocol ellipses are declarations, not ineffectual runtime operations. Identifier errors include rejected values; callers handling untrusted input should sanitize at public recording boundaries.

files.method: Review full adapter, reproduce post-construction namespace symlink escape, implement no-follow FD access, add baseline-failing write and read-race regressions.
files.observations: SEC-LOCAL-001 fixed in working tree with FD-pinned enumeration and no-follow actual reads. Final focused local/content/byte suites: 163 passed. Full-suite and exact-head scanner qualification pending.

files.method: Review conditional writes, tenant prefixes, readback and legacy fallback behavior; existing fake-S3 tests exercised.
files.observations: V2 writes require IfNoneMatch and reject unsupported conditional implementations. Legacy v1 fallback HEAD-then-PUT is race-prone and treats arbitrary HEAD errors as absent; no live S3 IAM/durability qualification performed.

files.method: Read package export list.
files.observations: Exports protocols and local/S3 adapters; no runtime security decision here.

files.method: Full execution context lifecycle and ContextVar implementation; exception/exit paths and root-completed semantics.
files.observations: Explicit record_exception emits raw exception message/stack to the span. Managed exporter projects it away; independent host exporters remain outside this boundary. Root completed does not close inherited producers.

files.method: Read closed Pydantic record fields and from_payloads hash conversion; inspect corresponding side-effect test names.
files.observations: State and target/operation metadata are caller reports; committed does not independently prove remote mutation. No outbound business action here.

files.method: Full record/constructor read: read/write/erase hashes, source/key/tags and erase marker.
files.observations: Erase marker deletes nothing; free-form labels are not demonstrated PII removal. SHA256 content fingerprints can reveal low-entropy equality.

files.method: Full record/helper read and hash list/count validation, source/document-ID metadata flow.
files.observations: Helper enforces hash shape/count; source-document IDs and labels are caller supplied. Direct Pydantic construction is less restrictive than helper per-result hash checks; managed route remains necessary.

files.method: Full Ed25519 verification read: closed JSON, duplicate rejection, domain bytes, external trust key, exact expectation, issued/current validity, revocation and fail-closed result.
files.observations: No signature primitive bypass found in inspected path. Authentication covers issuer statement, not underlying fsync, independence or hidden operations.

files.method: Full resolver read including every ancestor FD, private owner/mode, hardlinks, bounded object read and before/after stat; ExitStack callbacks.
files.observations: No ordinary exception-path FD leak found. No telemetry URI read. Owner-controlled root is authorization, not proof of operational independence.

files.method: Full expectation/manifest/row/signature/resolver logic read: exact attempt sets, cursor continuity, stream order, total byte bound and digest checks.
files.observations: Authenticates witness then resolves original bytes; result excludes raw bytes. Native operation ledger must be separately obtained; Fabric cannot establish witness independence from same fixture data.

files.method: Read data contracts, canonical parse, source registry/context graph, epoch chains, sequence/child joins, witness equality, role separation, durable store methods.
files.observations: Declared detached/unjoined children force incomplete; undeclared producers depend on independent inventory. Store uses path-based ancestor traversal; same-owner path mutation is outside hardened FD model. Local signatures are not production qualification.

files.method: Independent read of grouped closed fields, fingerprint capture and propagation checks; report privacy fingerprint injection concern to owner.
files.observations: Final reread confirms non-original governed fingerprint rejection; complete bound field set retained.

files.method: Full new resolver read and new tests: identity/policy/plane binding, fresh store read, materialized length/hash, fixed refusal statuses.
files.observations: Reported evidence_ref_for authorization outside try; owner moved it inside. Exact-original digest+length now required. Available remains source_trust=unverified and never a complete-run verdict.

files.method: Read full new projection diff plus call field/counter validators; compare immutable journal binding with settled snapshot enrichment.
files.observations: Final reread confirms failed persistence may change availability representation without invalidating original capture binding; regression proves failed observations project. Receipt normalizer compatibility fixed.

files.method: Inspect journal closed-key/validator changes and earlier sealing contract/readback semantics.
files.observations: New join fields validated before persistence; source status pending remains historical admission observation. Did not re-audit every existing recovery branch in this expansion.

files.method: Full exact receipt verification and OTLP normalization read; implement and test governed closed metadata compatibility after baseline failure.
files.observations: Shared complete grouped validation now preserves governed fields; bound is exact recognized-key union. Unknown keys, duplicate attrs, malformed fingerprints/counters still fail. 65 receipt/qualified tests passed.

files.method: Full principal-binding/authority intersection read.
files.observations: Fixed policy/workload/tenant expected claims and least-privilege binding. Wrapped authority must independently verify credentials/expiry; wrapper is not authentication service.

files.method: Full feature matrix and sdk_capabilities source read.
files.observations: Source support declarations explicitly state not active-hook attestation and not production qualification.

files.method: Full hash and digest-validator source read.

files.method: Read identifier warning/rejection paths and bounded embedded PII scanner.
files.observations: Warnings include rejected/PII-shaped raw values in stderr, outside managed OTLP exporter. Placeholder policy is not a privacy sanitizer; no claim of arbitrary PII detection.

files.method: Full generic HMAC/Ed25519 primitive wrapper read.
files.observations: Optional dependency absence fails false; generic API lacks evidence-attestation purpose/time/tenant authority semantics. HMAC public_key parameter is shared secret; must not be emitted.

files.method: Targeted lines370-465 legacy spool record/write/recovery plus automated whole-file AST sink review.
files.observations: Legacy spool persists base64 raw content with checksum, not encryption; path-based writes and exc_info logging differ from encrypted DurableByteSpool. Do not conflate guarantees.

files.method: Read mapping copy/load and comparison API; AST filesystem surface.
files.observations: Trusted caller-selected JSON file is read; match/deviation is only configured hash comparison, no action enforcement.

files.method: Targeted owner/root checks, SQLite configuration, ingress transaction/capacity/readback and receipt methods135-225/300-385; whole-file AST sink review.
files.observations: Parameterized SQLite insertion and BEGIN IMMEDIATE serialize check/admit. Owner-only path checks do not protect against every same-owner ancestor swap. Local SQLite FULL is explicitly not cloud durability/KMS proof.

findings.severity: high conditional on namespace mutation access
findings.description: Local filesystem tenant/evidence/meta symlink installed after construction redirects writes outside authorized root; ordinary path reads permit sidecar or validation-to-use swaps.
findings.evidence: Harmless tempfile reproduction returned symlink_write_escaped_root=true and returned_ref_lexically_inside_root=true. Three parameterized write regressions failed baseline with DID NOT RAISE. Added FD-pinned no-follow read/write traversal and fixed-root normalization.
findings.limitations: Requires ability to mutate configured filesystem namespace. GovernedLocalContentStore was unchanged.

findings.description: Legacy masked_only/original_plus_masked transforms execute on worker after raw memory enqueue. Only DeploymentPolicy/ContentProtector supports prequeue protection.
findings.tests: test_deployment_policy.py::test_real_recorder_routes_only_protected_bytes intercepts queue contents for deployment modes; do not generalize to legacy policy.

findings.description: Root outcome and existing-call seal refusal cannot enumerate detached producers that have not emitted/registered activity. Inherited ContextVar can outlive root.
findings.tests: test_distributed_closure.py::test_detached_unjoined_child_is_not_finalized_by_parent_completion rejects already declared unjoined child; it does not demonstrate automatic discovery of undeclared runtime tasks.

findings.description: ContentProtector.protect invokes arbitrary synchronous customer redactor on caller thread; payload bound does not impose redactor time bound. No universal no-delay claim is supported.

Legacy _write_verified_fallback uses HEAD then unconditional PUT and catches every HEAD exception as absence. V2 put_bytes_object deliberately avoids fallback; live backend behavior remains unqualified.

Governed call projection introduced attributes rejected by closed receipt normalizer; added exact recognized fields plus shared grouped validation. Baseline positive regression failed before fix; seven new checks and existing receipt/qualified tests pass.

Execution, Decision and legacy call code explicitly record exception on host spans. Managed exporter strips events; independent host exporters are not protected. PII warnings also echo input values outside OTLP.

Unbounded base64 incoming context JSON could raise RecursionError, contrary to never-raise contract. Baseline regression with10000 nested arrays failed; input/header/member bounds and decoder recursion containment fix now passes49 propagation tests.

Legacy verifier accepts only ByteEvidenceResolver; it derives stage receipt metadata from settled snapshots(status stored), whereas JournalMetadataSender transports immutable pending admissions. Normalized exact-set digests differ; governed reconstruction availability is not qualified complete-run verification.

evidence.method: Build actual governed projected streaming event through project_call_snapshot then change only status from pending to stored and normalize each with metadata_entries. No source change or business action.

findings.description: Legacy ContentResolver returns str(ValueError) from configured store; legacy _content_writer logs exc_info and stores raw content base64 in spool. These guarantees differ from fixed-error governed resolver/encrypted byte spool.
